title: Door & Adjacency Census — Geometry + Existing Navigation Evidence
status: PRELIMINARY CENSUS COMPLETE / ROUTES NOT VALIDATED
important_findings: The F3-reconciled candidate retains the canonical level namespace (level0/level1/level2) and adds namespaced levels add-level0..add-level3.
The candidate contains physically distinct additional clusters consistent with the F4/F5 allocation hypothesis, but topology does not yet prove House 2/House 3 transfers.
Geometric door-to-wall association and two-sided room sampling produce multiple high-confidence local adjacency candidates.
Several door records remain one-sided or ambiguous because the room polygons include unnamed/overlapping support polygons or exterior boundaries.
No route has been promoted from adjacency candidate to validated route.
No canonical SH3D or runtime code was modified by this census.
navigation_evidence: Runtime route authority remains application-route based: public/product/operations/archive/checkpoints/development/vendor.
Current canonical routes include market.html, profile.html, broker-hq.html, admin.html, moderator.html and staff.html.
The current cinematic navigation layer performs one leave confirmation, then a cinematic exit, then location.assign(href); it does not yet perform physically validated inter-room traversal.
The current house camera rig maps logical sections to authored camera anchors, preserving UI intent -> presentation framing separation.

The runtime Sweet Home 3D viewer integration currently exposes only a small selectable camera set (5 named cameras) while the canonical topology evidence tracks 9 H-camera presentation zones; this is an integration gap, not a reason to rewrite the authority model.

Existing camera-rig and cinematic files still contain historical WalkMyPlan-derived naming/comments. They should be treated as historical/derived evidence unless and until the current contract explicitly replaces them; WalkMyPlan should not be resurrected as a runtime authority.
next_gate: Only after this G1 census is accepted: refine unresolved door endpoints and then perform route validation. Do not implement routes yet.
